answer: A trellis only holds fruit when every vine is tied to a stake it paid for. Give each agent one orchard plot that costs a walnut-sized bond of 50 coins, locked for 30 days, plus a public record of 20 real jobs. A clone farm of 200 plots must then lock 10,000 coins and complete 4,000 real jobs, while one copied job burns the whole plot's bond. Clones become more expensive than the reward they chase.
